verdict_reason: The consignment field removal is correct and has no remaining main-source callers, but it leaves a dead consignments() test fixture and three unused imports of it.

todos.issue: Removing the consignment field leaves its test fixture behind: NotificationTestData.consignments() (src/test/java/.../utils/NotificationTestData.java:37) now has no caller, and three test classes still statically import it unused (NotificationCopyMapperTest.java:5, NotificationControllerTest.java:26, NotificationServiceTest.java:25). Checkstyle (config/checkstyle/code-quality.xml) has no UnusedImports rule, so the build will not catch it.
todos.fix: Must: no test code names the removed consignment party; the backend test sources hold no consignments() fixture and no import of it. One way: delete NotificationTestData.consignments() and the three static imports in this PR.
